summary: A pool of two Sahi connections, one instrument each: a sparse quote tick keeps the price band its connection carried when another connection opens and when another connection reconnects; only the instrument of the connection that was replaced starts afresh (audit R107-04).

notes: The pool is the session's (broker_runtime::pool_limits: Sahi's three connections) with one instrument per connection for the case.
The web's replay runs one adapter for the whole pool; Sahi's web mapping keeps no per-connection state, so its frames are the same for either connection.

deviations.reason: Sahi sent no open interest for this instrument (open_interest, a proto3 optional, is off its ticks); the web publishes oi 0 for it (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload), a number the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out; decisions.md).
The web's alias of oi, sent as 0 with it for an instrument whose ticks carry no open interest; left out with oi (see oi).

The tick left the price band off (dpr_upper, a proto3 scalar, reads as 0); the web publishes upper_circuit 0.0 (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload), a band nobody sent. The desktop sends none for an instrument whose ticks never carried one.
A tick left the price band off (dpr_upper, a proto3 scalar, reads as 0) after an earlier tick of the connection carried it; the web publishes 0.0, the desktop keeps the band it was sent.
The tick left the price band off (dpr_lower); the web publishes lower_circuit 0.0, as upper_circuit. The desktop sends none for an instrument whose ticks never carried one.
A tick left the price band off (dpr_lower) after an earlier tick of the connection carried it; the web publishes 0.0, the desktop keeps the band it was sent.
